biotools.summary: ATCodeR is an R-tool that transforms free-text medication entries into the standardized Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) Classification System. The tool improves the standardization and analysis of systemic anti-cancer treatment data, especially for German-speaking regions.
